en-US.description: Tencent AI voice input tool that turns spontaneous speech into polished writing.
en-US.longDescription: Chatterfly is a Tencent AI voice input tool. Beyond transcribing speech, it understands context, intent, and scenarios so your spoken words become polished expressions, and it can act on what you say. Recognition stays accurate when whispering, in noisy places, or on weak networks, and it keeps learning your vocabulary across apps and scenarios.

zh-CN.author: 深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司
zh-CN.description: 腾讯 AI 语音输入工具，让随意说出的话成为恰到好处的表达。
zh-CN.longDescription: Chatterfly 是腾讯推出的 AI 语音输入工具，不只把语音变成文字，还能理解上下文，识别不同的意图和场景，让表达恰到好处，并听懂需求帮你执行任务。支持轻声、嘈杂、弱网环境下的识别，随时唤起，在各种场景和应用中积累词库、理解需求。
zh-CN.name: Chatterfly
